note: Qualitative archetypes of external conditions. They correspond to the Street Slice rain / heat modes. No rainfall depths or temperatures are implied.

scenarios.label: Heavy rain
scenarios.description: A short, intense summer storm on normally moist ground.

scenarios.label: Hot day
scenarios.description: A sunny summer afternoon with normal soil moisture.

scenarios.label: Hot drought
